The Editor wishes to thank Gwen Couzens and Sally Lucas for their assistance in typing the June and September issues of "The Belgravian" and, at the same time, extends a welcome to any budding journalist who would like to co-operate in the production of future gazettes.

Our thanks to Gwen and Bill Couzens for the great amount of work they once again put in for the jumble sale held on October 31st. It looked to me as if there was more to sell than ever before, and it was a sucess despite the fact that it was a rainy morning.

The jumble sale held at the Hall was a great success, mainly due to the hard work put in by Gwen and Bill Couzens. There was a good crowd, all eager to spend their money on bargains, and over fifty pounds was raised for the Club funds.
£67.73½p clear profit was made at our last jumble sale, due largely to the boundless energy and enthusiasm of Bill and Gwen Couzens.
One recalls from this brilliant gathering Gwen Couzens smile and the warmth of Mavis Thresher - the caustic humour of Pat Duncan and Ray Hall.

As you will have read in the last magazine we raised £67.37½ at the Jumble Sale held on November 18th. My thanks to Gwen and Bill Couzens who did the bulk of the work and to the club members and their families who helped to make it a success.
Our thanks once again to Bill Couzens and his wife Gwen for the organisation. Also to the Club members and their families who gave up their time to help.

A jumble sale was held on March 30th and a good turn out by members and their families resulted in a profit of £45.06 for club funds. Our thanks to them and to ..... yes, you've guessed, Gwen and Bill Couzens.

Margaret McMillan and her great efforts at the Bazaar - Sue Coy - Mary Crookes and Stephanie Langheim - have all pitched in with their positive contributions. Gwen Couzens and Bill's Mum at the Jumble Sales. My own Mum, not Yidisha but a continuous source of lucrative ideas and help.

They don't come any more proud of their club than our President for 1975/76 Bill Couzens. Bill became a member of Belgrave Harriers at sixteen in 1952, introduced by his friend George Flanagan and the late Dave Martin Shepherd.

It is a coincidence that BILL COUZENS and his wife GWEN share the same birthday - but even more remarkable is the fact that this date fell on the very day of the Club Dinner when Bill was installed as Club President.
